answer: Each identity sells one walnut harvest future from its grove in an orchard and locks a 70-credit bond. Margins follow a posted ladder: the first future requires 30, the kth 30+6(k-1), so the 1000th requires 6024; 1000 fakes post 3,027,000 in margin plus 70,000 locked. A future is key-bound to its grove deed; at harvest the seller must deliver deed-matching receipts, and short delivery burns the bond and margin. A rented-harvest ring fails: rented receipts carry another grove's key, so the check fails and both bonds burn. An honest agent posts 30 once and reclaims it after clean delivery.
